notes.title: Loveland Demo v0.8.2 Now Available!
notes.notes:
​To celebrate Steam Mystery Fest, we have released update v0.8.2 of the Loveland Demo on all storefronts!

Update v.0.8.2 brings a host of new changes and bug fixes to the Loveland Demo, including (but not limited to):

[u][b]New FrogTox System[/b][/u]
Get higher then ever before with the new FrogTox system. It's still a work in progress, but it's far more intense then the previous systems. Go take a few swigs of Frogshine to see what we mean!

[u][b]Ability to Kick Frogs[/b][/u]
We are currently re-working the AI in Loveland to be a lot more aggressive in order to make the Frogs something to truly fear within Loveland. While those updates are still in the hopper, we have added the ability to kick frogs across the trailer park to better acclimate you with the Detectives offensive abilities once the Frogs become more... blood thirsty.​

[u][b]Updated Models and Textures [/b][/u]
No longer will Mr. Buchanan stare deeply into your soul after save him! Gone are the days where nobody blinks! With the update models and textures, Loveland has never been so creepily immersive.

[u][b]New Dialogue & Outcomes[/b][/u] 
We've changed up the dialogue in quite a few places, and have added a few different outcomes to what can happen in regards to helping out the Judas in Trailer 104.

[u][b]New  Video Options[/b][/u] 
We've added a few additional video options that let you better control your experience with Loveland. You may now adjust the level of pixilation as well as disabling/enabling Dither.

​And this is just all what we can remember offhand. There is a whole lot more see within Loveland Cove!

We hope you all enjoy the updated Demo. We're hard to work to make sure that Loveland is a memorable experience for years to come.
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Loveland Demo for Steam Scream Fest!
notes.notes:
A New Demo for Loveland is now available for download for the Steam Scream Fest!

The new demo features rewritten dialogue, as well as new additional mechanics and features, including the mysterious Phantom Frog.

We've also included new Video options that allow you to adjust resolution, the level of pixelation, and dither.

We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Loveland Demo Now Available on MacOS & Linux
notes.notes:
Even though Steam Next Fest is over, it doesn't mean the Demo's have to be!

MacOS & Linux Builds of the Loveland Demo are now available.

Please give it a try, and let us know if you run into any issues.

*Note*
We are aware of a bug in the Linux version where video files are not playing correctly. We are working on a fix for this, and will patch it as soon as possible.

notes.title: New Loveland Demo!
notes.notes:
Good Afternoon Detective.

It has been over one full year since your previous investigation into the Loveland Cove trailer park during Steam NEXT Fest 2021. 

A lot has changed since then, so we are dispatching you back out to the location in order to obtain updated intel into the frog-worshipping cult located within the confines of the park.

We wish you the best of luck in your investigation, Detective.
We know you'll need it.
